fact: At a working session on 13 August 2024, the DGMP's information systems director and its SIGOMAP project head presented the SIGOMAP public procurement system, which the DGMP itself initiated as its e-marchespublics project in 2016, to a Congolese delegation.
title: Coopération : une délégation congolaise s'inspire de l'expérience ivoirienne en matière de dématérialisation des marchés publics
